page_title: JUV 4-3 INT | Juventus v Inter 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+6' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Andrea Colombo's book.

90+1' 4 - 3 What a goal! Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes into the top left corner and behind the goalkeeper.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Juan Cabal (Juventus) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
89' The game is interrupted now, Marcus Thuram (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
87' Jonathan David (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
86' Andrea Colombo shows the yellow card to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) for a heavy challenge.

82' 3 - 3 Goal! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Kenan Yildiz, and he steers a powerful header from near the penalty spot low inside the right post. What a finish that is - 3:3!
81' The game has come to an end for Hakan Calhanoglu. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Petar Sucic (Inter).
79' Substitution. Federico Gatti makes way for Joao Mario (Juventus).
79' Here is a change. Weston McKennie is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Jonathan David (Juventus).
77' Substitution. Denzel Dumfries will be replaced by Matteo Darmian (Inter).

76' 2 - 3 Marcus Thuram (Inter) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:3.
75' Corner kick. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is ready to send the ball into the box.
75' Federico Dimarco (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
74' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Michele Di Gregorio punches the ball away.
73' The substitution has been made. Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) has replaced Teun Koopmeiners.
73' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic makes his way off the pitch and Lois Openda (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.
73' Igor Tudor decides to make a substitution. Manuel Locatelli will be replaced by Juan Cabal (Juventus).
70' The foul by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andrea Colombo.
70' Federico Dimarco (Inter) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

69' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
68' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
65' 2 - 2 Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
64' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Nicolo Barella and he is replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
64' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Lautaro Martinez is replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
64' Federico Dimarco (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Carlos Augusto.
62' An attempted cross from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is cleared.
59' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
57' A cross from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

55' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
53' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
51' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is about to take a corner kick.
51' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Juventus.
50' A pass by Carlos Augusto (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
46' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.

41' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.

38' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Yann Sommer just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
37' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
36' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
35' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) picks up the rebound on the edge of the box and shoots. His effort, however, only finds the gloves of the opponent's goalkeeper.
33' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
33' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
30' 1 - 1 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
29' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

29' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
29' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Weston McKennie (Juventus).
27' Nicolo Barella (Inter) will take a corner kick.
26' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
23' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
22' Nicolo Barella (Inter) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
22' Marcus Thuram (Inter) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Carlos Augusto (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
19' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Colombo interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Inter have a free kick.

17' Nicolo Barella (Inter) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. Juventus have been awarded a free kick.
16' Weston McKennie (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Inter, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
14' 1 - 0 Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom right corner. What a brilliant finish!
14' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

13' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
9' Marcus Thuram (Inter) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
8' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Andrea Colombo couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bremer (Juventus) and blew his whistle. That's a free kick to Inter.

4' Nicolo Barella (Inter) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Michele Di Gregorio scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
2' The resulting corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Juventus will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Andrea Colombo.
